origin.description: Write a data frame as newline-delimited JSON.

arguments.name: con
arguments.text: A file, a text stream, or omitted to print.

origin.details: The combined stream is not one JSON value. Each line is.
origin.value: Nothing. The lines are written to the connection.
origin.example:
x <- data.frame(a = 1:2, b = c("x", "y"))
con <- textConnection("out", "w")
stream_out(x, con, verbose = FALSE)
close(con)

arguments.name: con
arguments.text: A file, a text stream, or omitted to print.

translation.details: verbose is accepted and does not change the lines.
translation.value: Nothing. The lines are written to the connection.
translation.example:
import io
from jsonlite import DataFrame, stream_out
buf = io.StringIO()
stream_out(DataFrame({"a": [1, 2], "b": ["x", "y"]}), buf)
print(buf.getvalue(), end="")
